[SOURCE id=function_code:function:function-text:d319479344be kind=function_code issue=-1 path=function_code/2.libiec61850/function.txt]
IEC 61850 Function and Service Code Reference
=============================================

Important Note
--------------
IEC 61850 does not define one single "Function Code" field like Modbus.

IEC 61850 operations are represented through:

1. MMS PDU types
2. MMS confirmed service tags
3. MMS unconfirmed service tags
4. IEC 61850 ACSI service names
5. GOOSE EtherType and APDU fields
6. Sampled Values EtherType and APDU fields
7. Control model values

For an IEC 61850 function-code corpus, the MMS service tag is the closest
equivalent to a Modbus function code.

================================================================
1. IEC 61850 TRANSPORT AND PROTOCOL IDENTIFIERS
================================================================

TCP Port:

102 = MMS over ISO-on-TCP

EtherType:

0x88B8 = GOOSE
0x88BA = Sampled Values
0x88F7 = Precision Time Protocol

OSI transport commonly used for MMS:

TPKT
COTP
ACSE
Presentation
MMS

================================================================
2. MMS PDU TYPE TAGS
================================================================

0xA0 = Confirmed-Request-PDU
0xA1 = Confirmed-Response-PDU
0xA2 = Confirmed-Error-PDU
0xA3 = Unconfirmed-PDU
0xA4 = Reject-PDU
0xA5 = Cancel-Request-PDU
0xA6 = Cancel-Response-PDU
0xA7 = Cancel-Error-PDU
0xA8 = Initiate-Request-PDU
0xA9 = Initiate-Response-PDU
0xAA = Initiate-Error-PDU
0xAB = Conclude-Request-PDU
0xAC = Conclude-Response-PDU
0xAD = Conclude-Error-PDU

================================================================
3. MMS CONFIRMED SERVICE TAGS
================================================================

The following values are ASN.1 context-specific service-choice tags.

Template: UserInformation
- Field: mms_context_id
  Description: Protocol field 'mms_context_id'. Layer: presentation. Role: type. Type: uint8. Range: [0, 255]. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: direct_byte_parse. Evidence-type: memcpy.
  Length: 8 bits
  Implementation constraints: hard-coded in writer as literal 0x02 0x01 <value>
- Field: acse_context_id
  Description: Protocol field 'acse_context_id'. Layer: presentation. Role: type. Type: uint8. Range: [1, 1]. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: direct_byte_parse. Evidence-type: memcpy.
  Length: 8 bits
  Implementation constraints: value must be 0x01 (ACSE context identifier)
- Field: presentation_pdv_length
  Description: Protocol field 'presentation_pdv_length'. Layer: presentation. Role: length. Type: uint24. Constraints: length encoded in ASN.1 BER format, MSB of first length byte is extension flag, remaining 7 bits encode short form (0–127) or long-form length count (128–255 follow-bytes), actual value spans 0–16 777 215 bytes, must equal octet count of single Presentation-data-value ASN.1 OCTET STRING. Range: [0, 16777215]. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: direct_byte_parse. Evidence-type: tag_parse.
  Length: variable
  Implementation constraints: decoded by BerDecoder_decodeLength() returning consumed byte count, implementation limits maximum read to ByteBuffer->size, negative return aborts whole parse, carried inside tag 0xa0 (encoding choice) within the presentation PDV list (0x30), must be present exactly once per UserInformation ACSE encoding, value decoded before passing contained octets to upper (ACSE/MMS) layer
- Field: presentation_length
  Description: Protocol field 'presentation_length'. Layer: presentation. Role: length. Type: uint32. Inferred-from: wire.
[/SOURCE]
